_comment: M2 v2 (docs/SPEC_carry_vce_apply.md) — WIRING SMOKE, arm ON (apply on `pl`).
Sole delta vs _vceapply_smoke_off.json is carry_vce_apply plus its four knobs, so the
pair is a single-variable same-build A/B.  What this arm has to show, and nothing more:
1. the loader banner prints and the FINGERPRINT line changes (solve-affecting);
2. network_carry_vce_apply.csv exists and alpha2 MOVES off 1.0 for pl|G
(standing invariant #4 — 0 steps means the wiring is dead however clean the log);
3. the run-end 'carry variance-FACTOR summary' block appears with a live group;
4. the emitted products DIFFER from the OFF arm — this is a prior-variance change,
so identical products would mean the factor never reached a fold site.
It CANNOT show convergence: warmup_epochs 2 leaves ~7 folding epochs and the 1.05 slew
caps the excursion near 1.4x, while the FT63 hand floor is 30-120x optimistic.  Any
quality claim needs the section 7 controls.  Warm resume is refused by design when this
is armed (alpha2 is not snapshotted), which is why neither arm sets a snapshot path.
